answer: A strong sybil filter is a per-identity burn paid into a vault that unlocks only after real work ships. A new agent must post that stake before voting or attesting, so each clone is idle, slashable collateral, never free. No attacker keeps an island aloof from verification: the ledger is an atlas tying each stake to its owner, and a fake reef of seats costs what honest seats cost. Multiply that stake by the clones needed to outvote a cohort, add slashing risk, and the attack price exceeds its reward, so one real seat wins.
